classification_policy.mixed_questions: Classify at actual requested-clause level. Preserve source-backed core definitions/branches without lending them to the unproved producer or granting blanket credit to a mixed question.
classification_policy.novelty_warning: Eligible scope credit is not a claim that a retained clause is new or that the corpus is saturated. This audit awards no new questions and makes no global saturation PASS.
